transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, this is Dana. Can I verify you with your account number and PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Dana, account 335-901-668, PIN 2214, the name is Samuel Reyes. My service has been completely out for four days now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks Samuel, you're verified. Four days is a long time, what have you already tried?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything the last two agents told me. I've rebooted the modem, swapped the cables, done a factory reset, checked every connection. Two separate agents promised call-backs and neither happened. I'm exhausted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. When you say it's out, are the modem lights on at all, or completely dark?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Three are on solid, one is off. Same as it's been the whole four days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That one light being off usually points to the line not authenticating. Let me try refreshing the signal from my side, one moment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, go ahead, I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've sent a refresh. Can you tell me if that fourth light has changed at all, or is it still off?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still off. Nothing changed on my end, it looks exactly the same.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. Try one more full power-cycle of the modem for me, thirty seconds off then back on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done it... waiting for it to come up... and no, the same light is still off and there's still no connection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right. Honestly at this point there's really nothing more I can do from my side. It is what it is.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That can't be the answer after four days. Please transfer me to a supervisor, I need this escalated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No. I'm not going to transfer you to a supervisor.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm formally asking you to escalate this to a manager. It's been four days, that's my right as a customer.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I already told you no. I'm not escalating this, and there's nothing else that can be done.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You won't even try anything else, and you won't let me speak to anyone above you?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. There's nothing more to do here.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is completely unacceptable. My service is still down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
